summary: Loading-zone kerb on busy Stamford Road, no parking lane and shops adjacent.
reasons: Signed loading zone, weekdays and Saturday

drivers.seclusion: Retail premises and customer car park within 10 m; exposed to passing traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb abuts the traffic lane with no pull-off or verge.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial with signalled crossing nearby.
drivers.convention: Only a lone car on the road; loading zone sign marks it as short-stay.

sun_shade: Mostly open; one tree shades the east side near the start.
